said: Ok can you just accept all these as is?

autonomy.chose: A step's picture is the system's parts as a row of names, the ones the step touches lit, and the step's own fragment where it has one; a case dropped on it does not light a path
A part the builder makes is `guide/<part>.html`, not `details/<part>.html` as step 3's interface wrote it; a page started from a template stays in `details/`
Each video has its own guide, `<video-dir>/guide/` (the full page, a part a file, `parts.json`); a plan folder builds each of its videos'; a plan with no video, `<plan-dir>/guide/index.html`

The page is prototype v5's flow made general: a rail (outline, Expand all, gaps), then What changed (Built), a section a step, a section a kind of change, every choice, the decisions in force and the rest of `plan.md`; each a column of beats beside a stage, one column under 900 px; a layer a `<details>` with its summary; Expand all opens every layer, both sides of each section, each thing under its beat

Things to do are made from the blocks and the real runs, never written for a plan: the first six cases dragged onto What happens, the longest trace (three beats or more) put in order, the numbers and ✓/✗ words of the first printing interface part filled in, each question's options predicted; on the Built side six files sorted into their kind and a real run's ✓/✗ lines filled in
An explainer's source kept outside the repo (a transcript) shows its path, hash and lines, not its text; `--outside` builds a copy with it, masked, for this machine

A scene opens a part with `- guide: <part>[#<place>]`: a detail whose page is `guide/<part>.html` in the plan map (`guide: true`); the player offers it only once `guide/index.html` answers, and lists each step's part under the plan text's "Open:"
videos-that-make-sense's walkthrough: its seven prototype parts are the builder's now, same names (`- guide:` for `- detail:`, the frames' marks kept); their hand-built things to do go with them
A suggested edit's step and block come from its place ("step 1 · interface · …"); its ledger entry is kind `edit`, the reviewer's words chosen and the plan's the other option, active
An answer given on the guide goes into the plan video's record in this browser (`:decisions`, `via: "guide"`), the later kept; a part sends it to the player (`answer`)

walkthrough.md's Categories of change: `- **<name>** {<id>} (<paths>) (<commits>) (step N): <two lines>`, `Runs:` under it; a category claims a change of the plan's commits by its path and, where it names commits, only theirs; the first to claim it has it, and what none claims is "Everything else"

On the Built side a file the build writes (a plan map, captions, snapshots, pictures, audio, a rendered page) is listed with its counts, not shown; a changed line over 2,000 characters shows its first 400 and how many more; a file over 1.5 MB has no whole text, its changes still shown
The blocks are required of a plan whose folder is dated 2026-09-30 or later; `reel check --blocks` holds any plan to them
An option has an example when its text has a value, a quote, a command or a number (or "say", "e.g."), or a word of five letters or more of the question's "Say …" setup
"Says the video again" is a sentence of eight words or more of either video's narration found, letters and digits only, in the page's first layer (the beats, closed layers left out)
A scene's guide part whose frame marks nothing is a △ under `details_check: strict`, where an unmarked detail fails; the player shows the corner chip for it
